# pcd_images_image (Data Source)

Look up a single image in PCD's Glance service by id or by filters.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `image_id` (String) Look up by image ID (takes precedence over filters).
- `most_recent` (Boolean) If multiple images match, select the most recently created.
- `name` (String) Filter by exact image name.
- `owner` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `tag` (String) Filter by a required tag.
- `visibility` (String) Filter by (and report) visibility.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) md5 checksum.
- `container_format` (String) The container format.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `disk_format` (String) The disk format.
- `id` (String) The image ID.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Minimum disk (GB).
- `min_ram_mb` (Number) Minimum RAM (MB).
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether the image is protected.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size in bytes.
- `tags` (Set of String) Image tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC3339).
